title: Fert + PGR, Greens
last_load: Fairy Ring + Root Disease, Back 9 Greens, Tue 20 Oct (had HydroForce in it: rinse the boom first)
site_check: Spray signs out on every green. Greens mown, clippings and debris cleared
weather: Delta T 2–8 · wind under 15 km/h · under 25 °C · finished by 11am
extra_checks: Clean water run through the boom first
Yesterday's tank had HydroForce (wetting agent) in it
Greens mown, dew off, clippings and debris cleared
Poachek goes on dry leaf only
No GPS on the 5800: box out each green, then fill in
Every part of the green. Surrounds don't need it

products.why: The label says Companion goes in first, before anything else. There's no copper in this tank, so its copper restraint is clear.
Acidic (pH about 2). Big volume, goes in once the PGR is spread through the tank.

ppe_note: Poachek is a Schedule 6 poison and fatal if breathed in: mist mask, face shield and elbow gloves when you pour it, and the mist mask stays on while you spray. Grass Roots Iron and GreenMaxx are strong acids: goggles and apron. Eyewash on the rig.
spray_rules: No GPS on this sprayer: box out each green (a lap round the edge), then fill in. Every part of the green, surrounds don't need it
Greens mown, dew off, clippings and debris cleared. Dry leaf only
Get on now and be finished by 11. Poachek's label says not over 25 °C, and it gets to about 25 °C by 11 and 27 °C this afternoon
Spray when Delta T is 2 to 8. Stop if it's blowing off target
Foliar pass: do NOT water in. No irrigation or hand watering on the greens for 24 h
Ladies Foursomes Champs is off the 1st and 10th from 8:15am. Stay ahead of the field, never spray a green with golfers on or near it, and keep people off each green until it's dry
spray_more: Poachek label: fine spray in 500–1000 L/ha, don't spray above 25 °C, apply to dry turf and keep it dry for 24 h after, not on kikuyu or red fescue. Shadow Ultra: no rain or irrigation within 1 h, and no entry without protective clothing until the spray has dried. Phoz Fight: check compatibility before tank mixing.
post_checks: Greens irrigation off for 24 h and nobody hand watering the greens
Foliar pass: it has to stay on the leaf

flags.d: Label: don't spray above 25 °C. 16 °C at dawn, about 25 °C by 11am, 27 °C peak. Delta T 2.5 and calm at 4:45am, so the window is now: finish by 11, earlier if it warms faster. The label also wants dry turf, so greens mown and dew off before the boom goes on.

flags.t: No water on the greens for 24 h
flags.d: Foliar pass, and Poachek's label says keep the turf dry for 24 h after. Tonight's greens irrigation needs holding, and today's brief tells the crew to hand water dry spots after the greens work: keep that off the greens. 27 °C, 0 mm in 24 h and greens at 2.2 mm, so check the hot spots first thing Thursday.
flags.s: Poachek label · GreenKeeper sheet notes · #dailycoursesetup brief 21 Oct

flags.t: Ladies Foursomes Champs is off at 8:15am, not 3:30pm
flags.d: This morning's brief corrected it from the booking site: Round 2 is off the 1st and 10th, 8:15–8:45am, with no clear nine. The 3:30pm two-tee start is twilight. The sprayer has to stay ahead of the field, or work in behind it with people kept off each green until dry.

flags.t: Water volume is under Poachek's label
flags.d: Label: 150 mL per 1000 m² as a fine mist spray in 50–100 L per 1000 m² (500–1000 L/ha). This tank is 300 L/ha through Red AIC, a coarse air-induction nozzle. The sheet rate of 0.75 L/ha is half the label's 1.5 L/ha.

flags.t: Phoz Fight going into an acid iron tank
flags.d: Phoz Fight is pH 6.6–7.2 and its SDS says keep it from strong acids. Grass Roots Iron (pH about 2) and GreenMaxx (pH 2–3, 6% Fe) are in first, and phosphite and iron can drop out together. It stays last as on the sheet, into a diluted tank with the agitator running; its label says check compatibility first. Jar test per 1 L of mix, in page order: 680 mL water, 1 mL Companion, 1.7 mL Shadow Ultra, 33 mL iron, 117 mL GreenMaxx, 2.5 mL Poachek, 33 mL Phoz Fight, top up to 1 L. Look for cloud or sludge after 10 minutes.
flags.s: Phoz Fight label + SDS · Grass Roots Iron SDS May 2025 · GreenMaxx SDS Dec 2024

flags.t: Boom setup: about 317 L/ha at 4 bar
flags.d: Toro's own colour code: Red is the 0.4 gpm size (1.51 L/min at 2.76 bar). At 4 bar that's about 1.82 L/min a nozzle; on 50 cm spacing at 6.9 km/h it's about 317 L/ha. The rate controller will sit near 3.6 bar to hold 300 L/ha.
flags.s: Toro Multi Pro Spray Nozzle Selection Guide (metric, 50 cm spacing)

flags.d: Companion's label says don't use it with copper products. ASTRON (0.15% Cu) is off this tank, and nothing else here carries copper.
Yesterday's tank had HydroForce Ultra through it. Run clean water through the boom first so no wetting agent carries into a foliar pass.
GreenMaxx at 35 L/ha is about 9 kg N/ha (SG 1.31, 20% w/w) as stabilised urea, plus 1% Mg. If its 20% is w/v, it's 7 kg N/ha.
